notes: Verified S-level Greater Tokyo/Kanto catch-up discovery absent from canonical RADAR: The Bad Plus Farewell Tour at Blue Note Tokyo.

events.subtitle: Farewell Tour
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents The Bad Plus Farewell Tour on October 17-19, 2026, after the group announced that it will end its 27-year run. October 17-18 have 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets; October 19 has 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets. The announced quartet is David King, Reid Anderson, Ben Monder and Chris Speed. Blue Note Tokyo explicitly frames the engagement as a final-stage celebration of a band that fused jazz and rock and repeatedly reinvented its format.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a routine club return: The Bad Plus has announced the end of a 27-year run, and Blue Note Tokyo is presenting the current King-Anderson-Monder-Speed quartet for three farewell nights. The band helped make the border between jazz improvisation, rock dynamics and compositional eccentricity feel porous, and Tokyo has its own history with the group through the earlier Live in Tokyo recording. Hearing the final incarnation in this room gives the date real historical weight.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Worth crossing the metro area and protecting one of the six sets; the farewell context makes it substantially more important than a normal tour stop, though it is best folded into a broader Tokyo music trip rather than treated as a stand-alone transpacific trigger.

es.why_it_matters: No es un regreso rutinario al club: The Bad Plus anunció el cierre de una trayectoria de 27 años y Blue Note Tokyo presenta al cuarteto actual King-Anderson-Monder-Speed durante tres noches de despedida. La banda ayudó a volver porosa la frontera entre improvisación jazzística, dinámica rock y composición excéntrica, y Tokio además tiene historia propia con el grupo a través del anterior Live in Tokyo. Escuchar esta encarnación final en esta sala le da verdadero peso histórico a la fecha.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale cruzar el área metropolitana y proteger uno de los seis sets; el contexto de despedida la vuelve mucho más importante que una parada normal de gira, aunque conviene integrarla a un viaje musical más amplio a Tokio y no cruzar el Pacífico sólo por esta fecha.
